source_snapshot.items: FW Flash by WebUI - MB CPLD
source_snapshot.procedure: Upgrade or downgrade motherboard CPLD through WebUI, then perform an AC cycle after flash completion.
source_snapshot.script: Private Redfish firmware-check repository. Fifteen minutes attended and fifteen machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL but replaces the CPLD flash and required AC cycle with a GPU-driver TEMP_GB_PCB1~4 workload copied from the duplicate row.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Wrong testcase despite partial/risk posture; thermal evidence cannot validate CPLD programming or power-cycle recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores UI flash, commit gate, physical power control and board recovery.
historical_reviews.history: Sequence 946 is the row-781 dynamic PCB thermal variant; sequence 1048 is a different-code passive PCB display case. Both are excluded.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Firmware plus AC interruption requires separate explicit approvals, vendor-safe commit point, exact power timing and no automatic retry.

original_test_intent: Perform one approved motherboard CPLD upgrade or downgrade through WebUI, wait for the authenticated update to reach its vendor-safe commit state, execute the required controlled AC cycle, and prove board/BMC/host recovery at the intended version.
original_method: Bind the exact MB CPLD/board revision and image, preserve baseline, submit once through the documented UI, monitor commit, then have an authorized operator or validated PDU perform the specified off/on interval before post-cycle verification.
manual_activity: The owner approves image and both destructive phases; an operator verifies the UI target, supervises commit and performs or controls exactly the documented AC cycle. Automation collects UI, PDU, console and health evidence.
required_inputs: AC off/on intervals and safe-point semantics
Validated PDU or trained physical operator
Stable pre-flash power, console and rollback/external-programmer recovery
safety_requirements: Treat both programming and AC interruption as critical/destructive
Never start AC cycle before verified commit-complete
Do not substitute arbitrary BMC/SSH power commands or blind unplug
Stop workloads and confirm data safety
Keep power stable until safe point
Monitor PDU, console, BMC, POST, boot and devices
Never retry or cycle again without owner instruction
agent_execution_scope: After separate approval, control or record the exact AC off/on interval
Verify CPLD/BMC/BIOS/OS/device recovery without deciding verdict
engineer_actions: Approve image, update and AC cycle
Validate safe commit and power timing

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable: PCB thermal workload belongs to row 781 and cannot program MB CPLD, prove commit or execute the required AC cycle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI MB-CPLD workflow and validated PDU/operator procedure only after exact image, commit, timing and recovery gates are satisfied.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Upgrade/downgrade, WebUI, mandatory post-flash AC cycle, Script and 15/15-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a baseline-upload-commit-approve-AC-off/on-boot-recovery state machine with independent UI, PDU and console evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines the missing commit gate, power timing, physical control and recovery contract.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; successful programming is incomplete until the mandated AC cycle and recovered version/health are proved.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cycling before commit or using the wrong image can leave the motherboard unbootable and require external programming.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose direction and PDU versus trained operator, but must bind the exact motherboard CPLD/image, document vendor commit signal and AC timing, and preserve rollback/external-programmer recovery.
expected_evidence: Approval, board/CPLD identity, current/target versions and image signature/digest
Separate AC approval plus PDU/operator off/on timing and state
Console/POST/BMC/OS readiness and post-cycle CPLD/device/health comparison
Recovery record if invoked and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1503 consistently defines MB CPLD WebUI flash plus AC cycle; duplicate row 781 and related passive row 887 remain separate PCB sensor identities.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Image, commit semantics, AC method/timing and recovery are finite vendor/project prerequisites; execution waits for them but is not permanently impossible.

review_improvement: Replaces copied thermal work with two separately gated destructive phases and requires proof that AC cycling occurs only after commit and ends in full board recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: The mandatory AC cycle materially expands the blast radius beyond a normal firmware upload. It cannot be inferred or automated generically, but the vendor can supply exact commit and timing controls, making this REQUIRES with attended ownership rather than BLOCKED.
